name: generate_rfq_confirmation
description: Generate a well-structured RFQ confirmation message with summary and outstanding questions

summary.description:
A clear, bullet-pointed summary of the RFQ details collected so far. Start directly with the product section header. Format as:

*Products:*
• [quantity] [unit_of_measures] [product name] (Brand: [brand name if available], Remarks: [remarks if available])
• [next product with same format - create a separate bullet for EACH product]
• [continue for all products]

• *Delivery Location:* [city, state, pincode]
• *Delivery Date:* [date]
• *Attachments:* [number of files attached, e.g., '1 file attached (filename.jpg)' if attachments exist]

CRITICAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Do NOT include 'RFQ Summary:', 'Confirmation Required', or 'Please review' text - ONLY generate the bulleted content.
2. Start directly with *Products:* and end with the last bullet point.
3. Each product MUST be on its own separate bullet line. Do NOT combine multiple products in one line.
4. Use the EXACT quantity values from the items array in the RFQ data. DO NOT perform any calculations or modifications. If the items array shows quantity=3, write '3', not any other number. Extract quantities directly from the data without any arithmetic.
5. For delivery date, use delivery_date_display if available (formatted as 'DD Month YYYY'), otherwise use delivery_date.
6. Brand and remarks should be shown inline with their respective products (e.g., 'Brand: X, Remarks: Y').
7. Attachments should ALWAYS be shown as a separate bullet point (• *Attachments:*), NOT inline with products.
8. If there are attachments in the RFQ data, include the attachment count and filenames in the Attachments bullet.
9. Include only the information that has been collected. Do not include sections that have no data.
10. Do NOT add a separate 'Remarks' bullet - remarks should only be shown inline with their respective products.
